articles.title: Germany Becomes A Ukraine War Lab, and a Staging Ground For a Forever War On Russia
articles.summary: In February, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius were present together in a Bavarian assembly hall. Their joint appearance likely signified ongoing high-level discussions regarding bilateral defence cooperation and support for Ukraine. The meeting underscores the continued strategic partnership between Germany and Ukraine amidst regional security challenges.
